description: Combine image files into one multi-page PDF or a full-screen PDF slideshow (File > Automate > PDF Presentation), in the order given (a file may repeat), optionally adding the open documents, with slideshow timing, looping and transitions, file names on the pages, and Photoshop PDF save options

advanceSeconds.description: Slideshow: advance every this many seconds

files.description: Absolute paths of the source files, in page order

includeFilename.description: Print each file's name on its page

includeOpenFiles.description: Add the open documents that have been saved (Add Open Files), after files. Default false

loop.description: Slideshow: loop after the last page

pdfOptions.description: Photoshop PDF options, as for save_document's PDF options

pdfPreset.description: Adobe PDF preset name, e.g. "[Smallest File Size]"

slideshow.description: A full-screen slideshow instead of a multi-page document. Default false

name: make_pdf_presentation
title: Make PDF Presentation
